outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart showing mean±s.d. of three independent experiments for cell death (%). No individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is a bar chart showing cell death (%) presumably averaged, with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart showing mean±s.d. of three experiments over time points, with no individual data points shown.
Panel D is a bar chart showing cell death (%) with error bars but no individual data points overlaid on the bars.
